footnotes.text: 1. Regardless of individual course grades, students must maintain a minimum 2.50 GPA on all MUSC & MUED courses and a 2.00 cumulative GPA.

evidence.quote: 1. Regardless of individual course grades, students must maintain a minimum 2.50 GPA on all MUSC & MUED courses and a 2.00 cumulative GPA.

footnotes.text: 2. Some colleges require a minimum GPA for major courses. Courses indicated in this column are included in the major GPA for this program of study.

evidence.quote: 2. Some colleges require a minimum GPA for major courses. Courses indicated in this column are included in the major GPA for this program of study.

footnotes.text: 3. Students are required to participate in the major ensemble most closely related to their primary instrument. Students must declare a primary instrument upon acceptance into the program. Some ensembles require an audition for membership. Regulations for attendance at ensemble rehearsals & performances are different from regulations for class attendance. Members of ensembles are expected to be present at every rehearsal & performance, unless excused by the conductor. Courses which qualify for the Chamber Music requirement include all MUSC 130 courses with a suffix of A-Z and topics in: Voice, String, Percussion, Wind, Guitar, and Keyboard. Ensemble requirements are: a. Guitar: 2 major (usually choral), 6 guitar ensembles b. Jazz: 6 jazz ensembles, 2 major or minor jazz ensembles c. Organ: 4 major (usually choral), 4 accompanying d. Piano: 2 major, 2 accompanying, 2 chamber, 2 of choice e. String: 6 orchestra, 2 chamber f. Voice: 6 major, 2 opera workshop g. Wind/Percussion: 6 major, 2 chamber

footnotes.text: 4. MUED 155 and 156 are not required if taking MUSC 211P for Piano as primary instrument or if a student passes the proficiency exam.

evidence.quote: 4. MUED 155 and 156 are not required if taking MUSC 211P for Piano as primary instrument or if a student passes the proficiency exam.

footnotes.text: 5. Applied Music must be completed satisfactorily for a minimum of 8 semesters & 32 hours of credit.

evidence.quote: 5. Applied Music must be completed satisfactorily for a minimum of 8 semesters & 32 hours of credit.

footnotes.text: 6. Students in the Performance-Chamber Music concentration are required to demonstrate proficiency in one foreign language equivalent to the 122 course through course credit or the corresponding foreign language placement score.

evidence.quote: 6. Students in the Performance-Chamber Music concentration are required to demonstrate proficiency in one foreign language equivalent to the 122 course through course credit or the corresponding foreign language placement score.

footnotes.text: 7. The Carolina Core provides the common core of knowledge, skill and academic experience for all Carolina undergraduate students.

evidence.quote: 7. The Carolina Core provides the common core of knowledge, skill and academic experience for all Carolina undergraduate students.

footnotes.text: 8. Concentration Electives: Students must complete a minimum of 13 hours of concentration electives, including MUED 155 & 156, if needed. Students whose primary medium is voice must complete MUSC 278, MUSC 577, and MUSC 543 or 545. Students must complete a pedagogy course in applied area when available. For Bachelor of Music candidates with an emphasis in performance, a half recital is required in the junior year & a full recital is required in the senior year, as well as selection of one of following options with its required electives: a. Piano Pedagogy: MUSC 573-Performance Pedagogy (3); MUSC 573L-Pedagogy Lab. (2); MUSC 574-Performance Pedagogy II (3); MUSC 574L-Pedagogy Lab. (2); MUSC 575L-Pedagogy Lab. (2) b. Piano Accompanying: MUSC 268-Keyboard Harmony & Sight Reading Lab. (1); MUSC 269-Beginning Piano Accompanying (1); and 3 courses chosen from the following: MUSC 543-Song Literature (3); MUSC 545-Survey of the Opera (3); MUSC 549-Survey of Chamber Music (3); MUSC 578-German and English Diction (2); MUSC 579-French Diction (2)

The School of Music allows the use of the Pass-Fail option on elective courses. Further clarification on inapplicable courses can be obtained from the School of Music.
